text: [2026-05-13 do-beads loop] Claim released. Substantive correctness issue discovered after shipping PKIX-jbvb.2 and .3: my shipped DN rules don't match BR Legacy generation (the policy OID suffix I used). Filed PKIX-jbvb.6 (human-labeled) to decide between Option A (switch to Multipurpose OID .2, smaller change), Option B (loosen DN rules to Legacy semantics), or Option C (ship per-generation variants). PKIX-jbvb.1 cannot proceed until that decision lands because the choice affects what DnAttrRule SmimeOrganizationValidated should produce (Org-validated needs organizationIdentifier as SHALL across all generations — the bead description acknowledges this — but the strictness of the OTHER attrs depends on generation choice). Bead remains open.
